dedupe_keys.name: sub seasonal forecasts of european electricity demand wind power and solar power generation

description: The University of Reading publishes S2S4E forecasts of electricity demand, wind generation and solar generation for 28 European countries. The archive also contains the weather variables driving those forecasts and matching ERA5 estimates for verification. Two prediction systems provide daily values at leads reaching 44 days. Country aggregates are accompanied by gridded wind-speed products. The repository reports temporal coverage of 1996–2015; the describing paper gives different hindcast spans for the individual systems, so users must check the relevant file documentation before comparing periods. The archive offers separate ZIP packages for each variable, residual demand series, sample reading scripts and a README. Internal array formats were not confirmed in this review. Files are openly available under CC-BY-4.0 without a fee. A power-system modeller could use these ensembles to test forecast-sensitive reserve decisions or adequacy under weather uncertainty. They complement the historical meteorology in data-era5-reanalysis and the observed power-system series in data-open-power-system-data. National aggregation cannot represent individual network constraints.
